question: How are the world-cycle and the states of bondage and liberation grounded in the same power?
premises: The same divine power underlies all manifestation.
The world-cycle is a manifestation of that power.
Bondage and liberation are states within that manifestation.
inference: That very power is the world-cycle, and from it the states of bondage and liberation are established.
plain_english: That very power is this world-cycle, and from it the states of bondage and liberation are established.
